name: crawlmind-mcp

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Check that the Crawlmind server is running; reports its version and whether the embeddings add-on is installed.

tools.name: start_crawl
tools.description: Start crawling a website in the background and return its crawl_id immediately. Poll with get_crawl_status (use wait_seconds to wait with progress). Set wait=true to keep this call open until the crawl finishes.

maxPages.description: Maximum pages to fetch (default 1000). 0 means no limit: large sites can then take hours, so use it only when the user asks for the whole site.

maxDepth.description: Maximum link depth from the start URL

delayMs.description: Delay between requests to the same host

thinContentWords.description: Pages with fewer words of main content are reported as thin

allowPrivateNetworks.description: Allow crawling localhost and private network addresses

wait.description: Keep the request open until the crawl finishes, sending progress

tools.name: get_crawl_status
tools.description: Status and progress of a crawl. With wait_seconds > 0, waits up to that long for the crawl to finish and sends progress notifications meanwhile.

crawl_id.description: Crawl id returned by start_crawl or list_crawls

tools.name: cancel_crawl
tools.description: Stop a running crawl. Pages fetched so far are kept and analyzed.

crawl_id.description: Crawl id returned by start_crawl or list_crawls

tools.name: list_crawls
tools.description: Past and running crawls, newest first. Filter by site origin (https://example.com).

tools.name: get_summary
tools.description: Key numbers of a finished crawl (pages, status codes, links, TTFB) and the top issues, most severe first, each with up to 5 example URLs and a recommendation.

crawl_id.description: Crawl id from start_crawl or list_crawls

tools.name: get_issues
tools.description: List issues of a crawl, filtered by severity. With check_id, list every affected URL of that check (paginated) instead.

crawl_id.description: Crawl id from start_crawl or list_crawls

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Everything known about one crawled URL: status, redirect chain, metadata, timings, link metrics (inlinks, outlinks, click depth, PageRank score 0–100) and its issues.

crawl_id.description: Crawl id from start_crawl or list_crawls

url.description: Absolute URL of a crawled page

tools.name: get_links
tools.description: Inlinks (direction=in, default) or outlinks of a URL with anchor text, rel, placement (nav, header, footer, main, other) and target status. Inlinks include links to URLs that redirect to it.

crawl_id.description: Crawl id from start_crawl or list_crawls

url.description: Absolute URL of a crawled page

exclude_nav_footer.description: Skip links in nav, header and footer (content links only)

tools.name: get_top_pages
tools.description: Rank 200 HTML pages by internal PageRank, inlinks, click depth or TTFB. by=underlinked lists important pages (high PageRank or sitemap priority) with few links from main content: the best targets for new internal links.

crawl_id.description: Crawl id from start_crawl or list_crawls

tools.name: query_data
tools.description:
Run one read-only SQL SELECT against the Crawlmind SQLite database for questions the other tools do not answer. Always filter by crawl_id. Tables:
crawls(id, site, start_url, status, started_at, finished_at, pages_crawled)
pages(id, crawl_id, url, final_url, status, fetch_error, content_type, depth, in_sitemap, sitemap_priority, blocked_by_robots, redirect_count, ttfb_ms, download_ms, html_bytes, title, meta_description, h1_json, canonical, meta_robots, x_robots_tag, lang, word_count, content_hash, scripts_count, stylesheets_count, mixed_content_json)
links(id, crawl_id, source_page_id, target_url, anchor, rel, nofollow, is_internal, placement)
redirect_hops(page_id, hop_index, url, status)
external_links(crawl_id, url, status, error, final_url)
page_metrics(page_id, crawl_id, indexable, inlinks, unique_inlinks, main_inlinks, outlinks, external_outlinks, unique_anchors, click_depth, pagerank)
issues(crawl_id, check_id, severity, count)
issue_items(id, crawl_id, check_id, url, detail)

sql.description: A single SELECT or WITH … SELECT statement

tools.name: suggest_links
tools.description: Suggest internal links to add, from local multilingual embeddings: source pages that are about the same topic as a target but do not link to it yet, the paragraph where the link fits, and phrases from it that could become the anchor. Without target_url, under-linked important pages are prioritized. You write the final anchor and sentence. First use downloads a ~120 MB model and embeds the pages, which can take minutes. Needs the embeddings add-on; if it is missing, the user is asked whether to install it.

crawl_id.description: Crawl id from start_crawl or list_crawls

target_url.description: Only suggest links pointing to this page

tools.name: find_cannibalization
tools.description: Pairs of indexable pages that cover the same topic (very high embedding similarity) and have overlapping titles/H1s, so they compete for the same searches. Needs the embeddings add-on; if it is missing, the user is asked whether to install it.

crawl_id.description: Crawl id from start_crawl or list_crawls

tools.name: install_embeddings
tools.description: Install the optional embeddings add-on (about 700 MB of npm packages and a 120 MB model, stored in ~/.crawlmind) that suggest_links and find_cannibalization need. Call it when the user asks to install it, or agrees after one of those tools reports that it is missing. Takes one to a few minutes; does nothing if it is already installed.

tools.name: compare_crawls
tools.description: Diff two crawls of the same site (order does not matter; the older one is "before"): new and fixed errors and broken links, pages added and removed, pages that gained or lost the most inlinks, TTFB regressions, title and canonical changes, and issue counts.

tools.name: export_report
tools.description: Write a self-contained HTML or Markdown audit report (summary, all issues with examples, under-linked pages, strongest and slowest pages) to a file. The path must end in .html/.md and lie inside ~/.crawlmind/reports (the default) unless the server allows other paths; existing files are kept unless overwrite=true.

instructions: Crawlmind crawls websites and audits technical SEO. Typical flow: start_crawl, then get_crawl_status with wait_seconds until it completes, then get_summary, get_issues (with check_id for all affected URLs), get_page, get_links and get_top_pages. suggest_links and find_cannibalization use local embeddings from an optional add-on (install_embeddings installs it); compare_crawls diffs two crawls and export_report writes an HTML or Markdown report. crawlmind://checks/{id} explains each check.
